web.title: Reaction Mat Do: Poker Face Kitty Party Game Rules and Twists
web.description: Reaction Mat Do is a poker face kitty party game: hear a saas line, keep a straight face for 10 seconds, first to laugh is out. Rules, chit ideas and FAQ.
web.intro: Reaction Mat Do is a poker face game for a kitty party where two ladies sit face to face, one reads a funny saas or husband line from a chit, and the other must keep a dead straight face for 10 seconds. The first one to smile, laugh or speak is out, the winners pair up again, and the last poker face left wins. It needs only paper chits, a bowl, a phone timer and a dupatta for the final "Mummy ji round", where the reader plays the saas and the listener must answer every line with "Ji mummy ji" without cracking up.
materials: 20 to 30 paper chits, each with one funny saas or husband line
A katori or bowl to hold the folded chits
One dupatta for the final round
Two chairs placed face to face
A small prize for the winner
steps: Before the kitty, write one funny line on each chit in a saas or husband voice, like "Beta, kal 20 log khane pe aa rahe hain" or "Maine tumhare phone ka password badal diya", fold them and put them in the bowl.
Pair the ladies up. Each pair sits on two chairs facing each other, knees almost touching, while the rest of the group watches.
One lady of the pair is the reader. She picks a chit from the bowl and reads it aloud in a saas or husband voice, as dramatically as she likes.
The other lady is the listener. The host starts a 10 second timer, and the listener must keep a straight face the whole time: no smile, no laugh, no words.
If the listener cracks, she is out. If she lasts 10 seconds, the two swap roles and the reader now has to survive a new chit. The first to react loses the pair.
Winners of each pair form new pairs and play again until only two ladies are left.

In the final Mummy ji round, the reader covers her head with the dupatta like a saas and reads three chits in a row. After every line the listener must say "Ji mummy ji" with a straight face. Then they swap. The last lady who never laughed is the poker face queen.
rules: A smile, a laugh, a snort or any word other than "Ji mummy ji" in the final counts as a reaction and means you are out.
Covering your face, closing your eyes or looking away is also out.
The reader must read the chit as written; she may act it out but must not add her own jokes.
The host or two judges decide close calls, and their decision is final.
Each listener gets a new chit, so nobody hears the same line twice.
variations: Pati round: use only husband lines like "Khana kya bana hai?" or "Mummy aa rahi hain ek mahine ke liye".
Saas and nanad: two readers read together, one as the saas and one as the nanad, to make it harder.
Longer final: make the final timer 20 seconds while the rest of the room stays completely silent.
Team version: split into two teams and send one listener at a time; each survivor earns her team a point.
tips: Write lines everyone in the group knows from real life; familiar lines get the biggest laughs.
Keep lines kind and funny, never about a real person in the room, money owed, bodies or religion.
Seat the pair where everyone can see both faces, and let the room cheer but not talk to the listener.
Film the final on a phone; the moment someone cracks makes a great kitty memory.
Keep 5 extra chits for the final so the lines are fresh.

faq.q: How many players do you need for Reaction Mat Do?
faq.a: It works for 8 to 20 ladies. Everyone plays in pairs, so with an odd number the host can be the reader for the extra lady.

faq.q: What do you need to play the poker face game at a kitty party?
faq.a: Paper chits with funny saas or husband lines, a bowl, a phone timer, two chairs and one dupatta for the final round.

faq.q: What lines should I write on the chits?
faq.a: Short everyday lines in a saas or husband voice, like "Beta, kal 20 log khane pe aa rahe hain" or "Aaj kitty cancel kar do na". Keep them kind and familiar.

faq.q: How long does Reaction Mat Do take?
faq.a: About 10 to 15 minutes for 12 ladies, since each face-off lasts only 10 to 20 seconds.

faq.q: Is Reaction Mat Do good for older ladies or a seated kitty?
faq.a: Yes. Everyone stays seated, there is no running or cooking, and it needs no special skill, so ladies of every age can play and win.

lines.text: Shruti, kitty ke liye koi naya game batao na.
lines.say: श्रुति, किटी के लिए कोई नया गेम बताओ ना।

lines.text: Reaction Mat Do khelo. Main step by step batati hun.
lines.say: रिएक्शन मत दो खेलो। में स्टेप बाय स्टेप बताती हूँ।

lines.text: Chits ki katori, ek phone timer aur ek dupatta lo.
lines.say: चिट्स की कटोरी, एक फ़ोन टाइमर और एक दुपट्टा लो।

lines.text: Do-do ki jodi mein aamne saamne baith jao.
lines.say: दो-दो की जोड़ी में आमने सामने बेठ जाओ।

lines.text: Ek lady chit saas ki awaaz mein padhti hai.
lines.say: एक लेडी चिट सास की आवाज़ में पढ़ती हे।

lines.text: Saamne wali ko das second seedha chehra rakhna hai.
lines.say: सामने वाली को दस सेकंड सीधा चेहरा रखना हे।

lines.text: Halki si smile bhi nahi chalegi?
lines.say: हल्की सी स्माइल भी नहीं चलेगी?

lines.text: Nahi, jo pehle hasi ya boli, woh out.
lines.say: नहीं, जो पहले हँसी या बोली, वो आउट।

lines.text: Final mein saas dupatta odhti hai, jawab sirf ji mummy ji.
lines.say: फ़ाइनल में सास दुपट्टा ओढ़ती हे, जवाब सिर्फ़ जी मम्मी जी।

lines.text: Jo aakhri tak nahi hasi, wahi jeet gayi.
lines.say: जो आख़िरी तक नहीं हँसी, वही जीत गई।

lines.text: Bahut mazedaar! Is Sunday ki kitty mein yahi khelenge.
lines.say: बहुत मज़ेदार! इस संडे की किटी में यही खेलेंगे।
